sentences.text:
Shri Arun Kumar Paterya, learned counsel for the appellan
 Shri Harish Sharma - learned Public Prosecutor for respon
Heard on I.A. No.25639/2025, second application under Section 430 (1) of Bnss for suspension of
jail sentence and grant of bail to the appellant.

This Criminal Appeal under Section 415(2) of BNSS assails the judgment dated 20.02.2025 passed by Special Judge (POCSO Act) District Gwalior in Case No.59/2023 whereby, appellant has been convicted under Section 366, 376(1) of IPC, Section 3 and 4 of POCSO Act with maximum sentenced to 10 years RI with fine of Rs.300/- each with default stipulations.
Leaned counsel for the appellant submits that appellant has falsely been implicated in the crime and the Court below has wrongly appreciated the evidence and convicted the appellant.
Appellant has already suffered more than 1 year of incarceration as pre and post trial confinement.

Learned counsel for the appellant further submits that the appellant was 20 years old at the time of the incident and that the prosecutrix, in her initial statement under Section 164 of the Cr.P.C., admitted to being in relationship with him before allegedly changing her version in a subsequent statement due to external pressure.

Furthermore, the defense contends that the charge under Section 376 is unsustainable because MLC report confirmed that the hymen 2 CRA-3263-2025 was intact, a finding supported by the testimony of Dr. Shalini Khan (PW- 7), who stated that the medical evidence rules out the possibility of intercourse.
Hence, he prayed to suspend the jail sentence and grant of bail to appellant.
Learned counsel for the respondent/State vehemently opposed the application and prayed for its rejection.
Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record.

Considering the arguments advanced by learned counsel for the parties and especially looking to the testimony of PW-7 and the fact that final hearing of appeal will take long time, without commenting on merits of the case, I.A.
No.25639/2025 is hereby allowed.
